device.model: RPLIDAR A3 / Hokuyo UST-20LX 2-D LiDAR (Gazebo gpu_lidar)
device.name: rbot simulated 2-D LiDAR

facts.text: The 2-D LiDAR is a Gazebo gpu_lidar sensor named lidar_2d on the absolute /scan topic with update rate 15 Hz.
The sensor publishes 720 horizontal samples with resolution 1 and angle bounds -3.14159265 to 3.14159265 rad.
The sensor range is 0.30 to 25.0 m with 0.01 resolution and Gaussian noise standard deviation 0.01.
The sensor frame id is lidar_2d_link.
The ros_gz_bridge maps the absolute /scan topic from gz.msgs.LaserScan to sensor_msgs/msg/LaserScan in the GZ_TO_ROS direction.
The 2-D LiDAR mount comment names the topic /scan (LaserScan).
The architecture overview lists /scan as the 2D lidar signal consumed by the Nav2 costmaps and AMCL.
The sensor testing guide checks laser data with 'ros2 topic echo /scan --once'.
The README lists 2-D LiDAR among the simulated sensors.
The top-level simulation launch exposes lidar_2d_enabled with default true.
The Gazebo launch starts the ros_gz_bridge node with config/ros_gz_bridge.yaml.

determinism.notes: Event-driven canned LaserScan replies with no Gazebo raycast, noise model, physics step or wall-clock pacing; placeholder ranges do not replay a scan or a trajectory

fidelity.engine: analytic:ROS-free recording fake for the rbot /scan stream (no physics)
gaps: the fake is a ROS-free ros_transport handler: it answers the declared /scan subscription and records it, but runs no Gazebo Harmonic, ros_gz_bridge, sensor raycast, Gaussian noise model or 15 Hz wall-clock loop

the scan values and the returned 8-range array are placeholders, not the pinned sensor's 720 samples (src/robot/rlai_description/urdf/gazebo/gazebo_sensors.urdf.xacro:47-53); a live run must receive the operator's /scan from the Gazebo bridge
one subscription reply is not the pinned 15 Hz stream; the fake does not model message timing, drops or transport fragmentation
the package exposes only the 2-D LiDAR scan: the mobile base (/cmd_vel or Nav2 actions), IMU, depth/stereo cameras, 3-D LiDAR, GPS, TF and the simulator clock are NOT COVERED
the upstream /e_stop service toggles a software zero-velocity publisher and is not an input-free safe state; no motion command is exposed here
the bridge and sensor are Gazebo simulation interfaces; no hardware is attached and no live ROS graph is contacted

the bridge refuses non-finite JSON numbers, so a live scan whose no-return or out-of-range samples arrive as non-finite values fails the observation instead of returning it; the fake publishes finite placeholder ranges except in its non-finite test case

measures.description: Subscribe to one fresh sensor_msgs/msg/LaserScan sample on the absolute /scan topic and return its geometry, ranges and intensities
measures.name: read_scan

safe_state.description: The selected 2-D LiDAR is a passive range sensor with no actuator, stop or reset interface; this package commands no motion and declares no e-stop binding.  The simulator's /e_stop toggle is not an idempotent safe state and is not exposed.
